pages.title: Smells Like Tuna
pages.text: Smells Like Tuna, one of the 16 songs in Skitchin's CD Player, takes its title from Nirvana's "Smells Like Teen Spirit" (1991), the song that made Seattle grunge famous.

pages.title: Sharing a room
pages.text: EA was short of rooms, so composer Jeff van Dyck shared one with Traz Damji, who was writing the music for an NBA game. They could hear each other through their headphones, so they swapped parts and jammed together.

pages.title: A name cut short
pages.text: Skitchin's credits list the composer, Jeff van Dyck, as "Jeff Dyck."
